title: World of Individuals History Explorer export v1
description: Derived display package. Original trial values are preserved, not rewritten. Source membership must be independently verified before display.

trial.description: Unmodified semantic JSON of the original full 018 or 019 Trial. Source IDs, point ordinals and namespaces retain their original meanings.

timeline.description: Derived sorted navigation index. Same-tick order is presentation order, not a claim of new causation.

actors.description: Allowlisted activity inputs by flattened period/step then individual; null means no captured activity input.

reply_actors.description: Separately captured recipient response inputs, not activity inputs carried forward.

resource_actors.description: Own resource-decision fields only, keyed by original resource event ID.

causal.description: Additive extractor2 observer-only typed links. Discarded and rebuilt from original source on import, never actor cognition.
